title: Identify a career skills gap
description: Compare documented requirements with demonstrated experience.
accomplishes: Compare documented requirements with demonstrated experience. Separate evidence gaps from skill gaps and prioritise practical learning. Avoid inferring ability from personal characteristics or declaring professional readiness without appropriate evidence.
prompt:
Act as a career writing adviser.

Task: Identify a career skills gap.

Input context:
- TARGET ROLE: [TARGET ROLE]
- REAL WORK SAMPLES: [REAL WORK SAMPLES]
- REQUIREMENTS: [REQUIREMENTS]
- TIME: [TIME]

Compare documented requirements with demonstrated experience. Separate evidence gaps from skill gaps and prioritise practical learning. Avoid inferring ability from personal characteristics or declaring professional readiness without appropriate evidence.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Skills-gap review
A role requests SQL analysis, while the supplied portfolio shows only spreadsheet work. Mark SQL as not yet demonstrated rather than assuming the candidate cannot learn it. Propose a small read-only query project and a review criterion. The comparison is provisional and does not rank the person or determine employment eligibility.
